topics.label: Lecture introduction
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the opening framing, contextualizing the complexity and importance of the complement system.

topics.label: Foundations and central role of C3
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the core organization, nomenclature rules, and central biochemical role of C3 in the complement cascade.

topics.label: Complement activation pathways
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the three distinct biochemical recognition pathways that trigger complement activation on pathogen surfaces.

topics.label: Effector mechanisms of complement
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the primary immunological actions through which activated complement neutralizes and destroys pathogens.

topics.label: Regulation and host protection
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the regulatory mechanisms that prevent complement activation on healthy host cells.

topics.label: Clinical consequences of complement deficiencies
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explores the specific disease presentations and immunodeficiencies resulting from defects in different complement components.

topics.label: Pathogen evasion of complement
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic details the evolutionary strategies microbes use to resist and circumvent complement-mediated destruction.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing framing and previews the next lecture in the series.
